inlines.v: WINGED, participle passive 1. Furnished with wings; transported by flying. 2. adjective Having wings; as a winged fowl. Genesis 1:21. 3. Swift; rapid; as with winged haste. 4. Wounded; hurt. 5. In botany, furnished with longitudinal membranous appendages, as a winged stalk or stem; or with downy or hairy appendages, as winged seeds. WINGED petiole, having a thing membrane or border on each side, or dilated on the sides. WINGED leaf, a pennate leaf; a species of compound leaf, wherein a simple leaf has several leaflets fastened to each side of it. 6. In heraldry, represented with wings, or having wings of a different color from the body. 7. Fanned with wings; swarming with birds.
